$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (sub-shape of attestation:forget-decision's evidence_json.summary_metric). Category A. Outcome record for right-to-be-forgotten governance requests.
title: ForgetDecisionMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:forget-decision (mishpat). Records mishpat governance's decision on a forget-request signal. See observation-event-layer spec §9.4.

outcome.description: The forget-request decision: granted (full redaction), granted-with-redaction (selective fields), or refused-per-constraint (graduated-harm / accountability / evidence-dependency).

reasoning_md.description: Governance reasoning in markdown. Required even for grants; documents the deliberation.

constraint_applied.description: Manifest-declared constraint key that drove the decision (e.g., 'graduated-harm-tier-3', 'accountability-claim-live', 'evidence-dependency-outstanding').

redacted_fields.description: If outcome is 'granted-with-redaction', list of Content field keys that were redacted. Omit or empty for 'granted' or 'refused'.
